  </div>
</article>

HE is mentioned in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) as relating from ʿUbayd Allāh b. ʿAdī b. al-Khiyār, who is only mentioned by <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P070B</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 70) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P071C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 71)) in the story of how Waḥshī killed Ḥamzah. Also see <a href="WAKMW.html" class="witness-link">WAKMW</a> (Aḥmad b. Khālid b. Mūsā al-Wahbī al-Kindī), <a href="WHAYA.html" class="witness-link">WHAYA</a> (Yazīd b. Hārūn al-Wāsiṭī), and <a href="WAKMW.html" class="witness-link">WAKMW</a> (Aḥmad b. Khālid b. Mūsā al-Wahbī al-Kindī) who provide traditions from Abū Ayyūb al-Anṣārī and to al-Zuhrī.
